body.p: Lost man. A man went hunting. Went to another country somewhere. Then he got lost. It goes on and on. Suddenly he came to a tent. A large tent. The kind of tent they usually say melts into the snow. Into such a big tent, a big white tent, he wanted to enter the tent. Something has started to swarm, everyone is lying down. Something has stirred, it turns out that they have been gathered there. They sing and say: "Don't enter the tent, we are dead. We have died, the spark of fire falls on us, then we die. Now don't go into the tent, your soul will pass over to our side. Go home, you will go home, your house is not far away. You will find your home. It is impossible for a living person to look at us, we are here, already gone, away from living people." His song continues: Man. Go home, your tent is not far, you will find your home. [Otherwise] you will come to our site. Man, go, go home.
